resources.string: Enhances video clarity and GPU efficiency via MQSR (Meta Quest Super Resolution) and Snapdragon GSR shader processing.

Adds a soft glow behind the screen, colored from the video frame. Only visible in the Void environment. Vulkan only.

Rotates virtual speakers and soundstage when you turn your head for realistic spatial immersion.
Locks virtual speakers to the video screen instead of world space. Recommended for 2D flat content — keeps dialogue always in front.
Shows the physical world as background via Quest 3 cameras.
